scope: tracked root configuration and project guidance

nodes.label: Next.js routes
nodes.role: App Router pages and API handlers compose authenticated product surfaces for logs, decks, tournaments, stats, profile, admin, and public shares.
constraints: Authenticated product pages call requireUser or requireAuth.
Public share pages are token-addressed and do not expose owner-only notes.

nodes.label: React UI workspace
nodes.role: Shared browser UI, lazy editors, dialogs, route reporting, and client-side API calls.
constraints: Client modules use server actions or private API routes for mutations.
Shared shadcn primitives live below components/shadcn/.

nodes.label: Auth gateway
nodes.role: Refreshes Supabase sessions, forwards verified claims, protects authenticated routes, and supports OAuth callbacks.
constraints: Proxy matcher is intentionally narrow.
Production test-login is disabled; OAuth redirect origins are allowlisted.

nodes.label: Battle log workspace
nodes.role: Parses, imports, edits, links, annotates, paginates, deletes, and shares PTCGL battle logs.
constraints: Every mutation is scoped to the authenticated user.
Parsed sections are runtime-validated before storage.

nodes.label: Log import engine
nodes.role: Detects language, divides turns, derives battle statistics, identifies archetypes, selects sprites, and conservatively links decks.
constraints: Identification must be grounded in catalogue evidence.
Learned self-archetypes require a minimum existing-match threshold.

nodes.label: Deck strategy workspace
nodes.role: Creates and edits deck strategies, matchups, linked logs, and dated deck lists.
constraints: Deck and child mutations are owner-scoped.
Workspace revalidation follows successful writes.

nodes.label: Deck aggregate engine
nodes.role: Parses and canonically sorts deck lists, then atomically commits relational and compatibility representations through a database RPC.
constraints: Canonical ordering must succeed before a list is committed.
Optimistic child timestamps detect concurrent edits.

nodes.label: Tournament workspace
nodes.role: Records tournament metadata, deck snapshots and lists, placements, rounds, game results, and notes.
constraints: Tournament format must be in the synced site-format catalogue.
Round and linked-deck ownership are enforced in actions and database constraints.

nodes.label: Stats read models
nodes.role: Loads overview, damage timeline, and archetype matchup aggregates backed by database read-model functions.
constraints: Reads are scoped by authenticated user context.
Expensive summaries use SQL read models rather than client aggregation.

nodes.label: Public sharing service
nodes.role: Creates expiring immutable public snapshots, lists and revokes owner shares, and resolves short public tokens.
constraints: Snapshots omit owner-only match notes.
Creation is rate-limited, payload-limited, expiring, and token collision-safe.

nodes.label: Route telemetry
nodes.role: Normalizes privacy-safe route timings and client environment fields before persisting authenticated RUM events.
constraints: Dynamic identifiers are normalized from paths.
Numeric and text payload fields are clamped before storage.

nodes.label: Reference catalogue sync
nodes.role: Builds Pokémon species and card-effect reference catalogues from bounded upstream APIs and upserts them with service-role clients.
constraints: Cron requests require CRON_SECRET.
Payload identity, pagination uniqueness, and minimum usable catalogue checks fail closed.

nodes.label: Supabase client adapters
nodes.role: Constructs cookie-aware server, anonymous public, and service-role Supabase clients; lib/db groups typed queries behind product functions.
constraints: Service-role client is server-only.
Server client requires public URL and anonymous key environment variables.

nodes.label: Supabase Postgres
nodes.role: Authoritative relational store for profiles, logs, decks and aggregate children, tournaments, shares, catalogues, read models, roles, and telemetry.
constraints: Tenant data uses row-level security and owner foreign keys.
schema.sql is the complete bootstrap snapshot; historical SQL is not replayed blindly.

evidence.symbol: alter table public.logs enable row level security

nodes.label: Limitless TCG
nodes.role: External card metadata, canonical deck ordering support, card assets, and current Standard-format discovery.
constraints: Deck metadata fetches fall back to empty results, but canonical save fails if sorting cannot complete.
Site-format discovery falls back to built-in options.

nodes.label: PokéAPI + Pokémon TCG API
nodes.role: External species, evolution-chain, localized-name, and card-effect source data for scheduled catalogue sync.
constraints: Fetches use explicit page and payload boundaries.
Optional Pokémon TCG API key only raises upstream rate limits.

nodes.label: Training Court logs
nodes.role: Optional external HTML source for importing PTCGL logs when the user supplies a supported Training Court URL.
constraints: Only allowlisted Training Court URLs are accepted.
Fetch timeout is 10 seconds and reconstructed content must pass structural checks.

nodes.label: Vercel Cron
nodes.role: Invokes the Pokémon catalogue sync route daily; no application queue implementation was found in the scanned source.
constraints: Only the Pokémon catalogue cron is configured in vercel.json.
No source-backed queue or subscriber module exists in the scanned scope.

flows.label: Battle-log import
flows.trigger: A user pastes a PTCGL log or supported Training Court URL and confirms the parsed review.
flows.outcome: A validated, identified, optionally deck-linked log is stored and downstream stats refresh.

flows.label: Canonical deck-list save
flows.trigger: A user saves a raw deck list inside a deck strategy.
flows.outcome: Parsed and canonically ordered cards are atomically committed to the deck aggregate.

flows.label: Tournament recording
flows.trigger: A user records tournament details, a list, or a round result.
flows.outcome: Owner-scoped tournament evidence and any linked deck-list snapshot are persisted.

flows.label: Public battle-log share
flows.trigger: A user creates a share link and a visitor later opens its short token.
flows.outcome: An expiring owner-safe snapshot is stored and rendered through the public route.

flows.label: Scheduled catalogue refresh
flows.trigger: Vercel Cron invokes the authenticated daily Pokémon catalogue route.
flows.outcome: Validated species and card-effect reference rows are upserted and reference caches are refreshed.
